data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'janah' meaning 'womb' or 'source'. Jena is a beautiful name for a girl, symbolizing the source of life and love. In Islamic culture, it is also associated with the beautiful names of the Prophet's wives, such as Jawhariyah, who was known for her beauty and grace. The name Jena carries the meaning “Daughter of Janah or beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jena usually hope their child will grow to embody daughter of janah or beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
